response.rationale: Both Malay answers correctly express the intended sense, but the relation label "different-common-word" overstates the regional distinction. Malaysian references also attest rendah hati, while merendah diri is a valid humility expression. Treat this as a shared-synonym/preference contrast, with a possible aspect/register nuance rather than a false friend.
